convention_discrepancies.issue: The source presents a special CSS case with an additional dual-containment hypothesis (written there with C0 notation).
convention_discrepancies.local_treatment: The controlling QC20 plan and Preskill §7.7 use only C2 subset C1. The local theorem and example preserve that general nested-code convention and do not import the extra inclusion.

convention_discrepancies.issue: Its stabilizer convention treats Y=ZX as anti-Hermitian and tracks only real signs in the cited presentation.
convention_discrepancies.local_treatment: QC20 uses the Hermitian Y=iXZ convention and phase-aware i^k X^x Z^z Paulis. The local facts and proofs state and use the current convention explicitly.

convention_discrepancies.issue: Their planar patch orientations/rough-smooth labels differ from the fixed QC20 coordinate patch.
convention_discrepancies.local_treatment: The local definition fixes left/right rough edges, top/bottom dual boundaries and exact relative boundary matrices; the path proof is local.

convention_discrepancies.issue: The source proves a different 11-round canonical circuit form and its global circuit-synthesis gate count.
convention_discrepancies.local_treatment: The local encoder is direct phase-aware pivot elimination with its own termination, correctness and per-pivot gate-count proof; the source canonical-form claim is explicitly out of scope.
